digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store mounting
propositions: rebar init must not create an orphan branch when ticket fetch fails or remote is unreachable

A tri-state remote probe (advertised, reachable-absent, unreachable) must be shared by _mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, and _create_tracker to distinguish network failure from genuine first-init
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable remote as do-not-auto-mount and return without error, while strict init paths fail closed with actionable diagnostics
The new --force-new-store flag must permit deliberate bootstrap only when reachability cannot be established; with reachable remotes it must warn and follow normal behavior
Advertisement probe must use a short bounded timeout via git ls-remote with cached tri-state result, while cold fetch retains its 300-second bound
Failure messages must name configured remote, branch, timeout where applicable, and concrete remediation steps (fetch-retry or force-new-store override)
